answer: Show me a timber with a history, a sable with a receipt, a island with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Felt beater beaver fur mark felted into the blocking frame, and the receipt must read each beaver fur is a felting record witnessed by the master felter. Honest work runs 17 minutes a proof; the farm needs 448 proofs, which is 7616 minutes it cannot paint. Checking is dull by design: the paint stays fresh, the mark gets checked, the date stays fixed.
